title: On connected periodic planar graphs, sufficiently dense zeros force positive-weighted harmonic functions to vanish in inner balls
author: Ahmed Bou-Rabee, William Cooperman and Shirshendu Ganguly
difficulty_reason: The proof uses planar noncrossing of positive and negative level components to bound the proportion of zeros on a contour. Effective-conductance reductions remove finite bridge and double-edge obstructions in the dual graph. A sparse-nonzero boundary selection and a carefully constructed surrounding cycle then force a contradiction between harmonic maximum principles and the planar contour bound.
